reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=633 of 2000) that cuts power. On the full sample with the same pre-period controls, the training coefficient is about 0.58 (SE 0.23, p≈0.012), and in the south it is about 0.97 (p≈0.01). The north estimate is just an imprecise null, not evidence of no effect, and the report does not disclose that this subsample was selected.
